```{r setup, include=FALSE}
set.seed(42)

report_date <- "20261016"

phyloseq_dir <- "Phyloseq"
dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(phyloseq_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

group_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "#D55E00",
  "True" = "#0072B2",
  "Mock" = "#009E73"
)

subject_pair_colors <- c(
  "KSY" = "#E78AC3",
  "PYH" = "#66A61E"
)

soyeon_theme <- theme_classic(base_family = "Noto Sans CJK KR", base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.45),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  )

theme_set(soyeon_theme)

cycle_levels <- c(
  "PCR1_33__PCR2_8", "PCR1_33__PCR2_10",
  "PCR1_35__PCR2_8", "PCR1_35__PCR2_10"
)

datatable_basic <- function(x, page_length = 10) {
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "none",
    extensions = character(0),
    options = list(
      dom = "tp",
      pageLength = page_length,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    )
  )
}

analysis_method <- params$analysis_method
analysis_qc <- "QC20"
analysis_maxee <- "2,2"
input_phyloseq_file <- params$input_phyloseq_file

if (!file.exists(input_phyloseq_file)) {
  stop("ITSxpress QC20/maxEE 2,2 phyloseq RDS를 찾을 수 없습니다: ", input_phyloseq_file)
}

phy <- readRDS(input_phyloseq_file)
if (!inherits(phy, "phyloseq")) stop("입력 RDS가 phyloseq object가 아닙니다.")

# 01_Preprocessing_2.Rmd에서 생성·정리된 ITSxpress Single 전용 phyloseq를 직접 사용한다.
q2_metadata <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(phy), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample_Type = factor(Sample_Type, levels = c("Control", "True", "Mock")),
    Control_Type = factor(
      Control_Type,
      levels = c("Air swab", "Clean bench swab", "Empty tube", "Skin sample", "Mock")
    ),
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(
      PCR_Cycle_Group,
      levels = cycle_levels
    )
  )

sample_frame <- q2_metadata |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("SampleID") |>
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
phyloseq::sample_data(phy) <- phyloseq::sample_data(sample_frame)

# 안전 확인: preprocessing RDS의 Fungi와 양의 read를 가진 sample/taxa만 유지한다.
kingdom_loaded <- as.character(phyloseq::tax_table(phy)[, "Kingdom"])
phy <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(kingdom_loaded == "Fungi", phy)
phy <- phyloseq::prune_samples(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy) > 0, phy)
phy <- phyloseq::prune_taxa(phyloseq::taxa_sums(phy) > 0, phy)

preprocessing_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  Stage = "Loaded ITSxpress QC20 / maxEE 2,2 fungal phyloseq",
  Samples = as.integer(phyloseq::nsamples(phy)),
  Taxa = as.integer(phyloseq::ntaxa(phy)),
  Total_Reads = as.numeric(sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy)))
)

kingdom_before <- tibble::tibble(
  Kingdom = as.character(phyloseq::tax_table(phy)[, "Kingdom"]),
  Reads = as.numeric(phyloseq::taxa_sums(phy))
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Kingdom) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Taxa = as.integer(dplyr::n()), Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Status = "Retained")
kingdom_after <- kingdom_before |>
  dplyr::select(Kingdom, Taxa, Reads)

otu_matrix <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(phy), "matrix")
if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu_matrix <- t(otu_matrix)

taxonomy_matrix <- data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(phy), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Display_Taxon = dplyr::case_when(
      Species != "" ~ stringr::str_replace_all(Species, "_", " "),
      Genus != "" ~ paste0(Genus, " sp."),
      Family != "" ~ paste0(Family, " (unclassified)"),
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified fungi"
    )
  )

sample_info <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(phy), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Read_Depth = as.numeric(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy)[SampleID]))

subject_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(sample_info$Subject)))
subject_shapes <- stats::setNames(
  rep(0:20, length.out = length(subject_levels)),
  subject_levels
)
```

# 1. Dataset

## 분석 목표 및 입력

- 분석 목표: True skin sample과 negative control 간 alpha diversity, beta diversity 및 taxonomic composition 차이의 기초 확인
- phyloseq 입력: `01_Preprocessing.Rmd`에서 생성한 QC20 / maxEE 2,2 / ITSxpress fungal ASV phyloseq object
- diversity 입력: non-rarefied ASV count를 사용함. alpha diversity는 raw ASV count, Bray–Curtis는 relative abundance, Jaccard는 presence/absence로 계산함
- rarefaction: sample filtering 또는 분석 포함 기준으로 사용하지 않고 sequencing depth에 따른 observed richness 추이만 제시함
- 추가 filtering: Kingdom이 Fungi인 taxon을 유지한 뒤 zero-depth sample 및 zero-sum taxon만 제거함. abundance threshold와 decontam은 적용하지 않음
- 연구 구조: 2개 skin subject와 3개 control source에서 PCR cycle 조건을 반복 측정한 탐색 자료임
- Skin sample은 대상자와 좌/우를 포함한 해부학적 site를 유지하며, 동일 biological unit에서 PCR 조건별 library가 반복된 구조로 분석함

## Phyloseq preprocessing 및 taxonomy 검증

- `01_Preprocessing.Rmd`에서 count, taxonomy, metadata 결합과 taxonomy 정리 및 Kingdom filtering을 마친 ITSxpress phyloseq RDS를 직접 불러옴.
- ITS2 분석이므로 불러온 object에서 `Kingdom == Fungi`와 양의 sample/taxa count를 다시 확인함.
- rarefaction, low-abundance threshold 및 contaminant removal은 preprocessing 단계에 적용하지 않음.

```{r preprocessing-audit}
datatable_basic(preprocessing_audit, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Total_Reads", 0)

datatable_basic(kingdom_before, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Reads", 0)

datatable_basic(kingdom_after, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Reads", 0)
```

```{r taxonomy-check}
taxonomy_check <- taxonomy_matrix |>
  dplyr::select(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 12)

datatable_basic(taxonomy_check, 12)
```

- 불러온 ITSxpress phyloseq의 sample, ASV, total read와 Kingdom 구성을 위 표에서 직접 확인함.
- 입력 object가 fungal-only인지 Kingdom level의 ASV/read 합계로 재확인함.

## Sample info

```{r sample-overview}
sample_overview <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::count(Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, name = "N") |>
  dplyr::mutate(N = as.integer(N)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group)

sample_totals <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c(
    "Metadata libraries", "Libraries used for alpha/beta/taxa",
    "Independent skin subjects", "Independent control sources", "ASVs"
  ),
  N = as.integer(c(
    nrow(q2_metadata), phyloseq::nsamples(phy),
    dplyr::n_distinct(sample_info$Subject[sample_info$Sample_Type == "True"]),
    dplyr::n_distinct(sample_info$Subject[sample_info$Sample_Type == "Control"]),
    phyloseq::ntaxa(phy)
  ))
)

datatable_basic(sample_totals, 10)
datatable_basic(sample_overview, 12)

skin_design <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "True") |>
  dplyr::count(Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, PCR_Cycle_Group, name = "Library_N") |>
  dplyr::arrange(Subject, Skin_Site, PCR_Cycle_Group)

datatable_basic(skin_design, 15)
```

현재 분석 metadata에서 Mock으로 식별되는 sample은 `r sum(sample_info$Sample_Type == "Mock", na.rm = TRUE)`개임. 본 보고서는 **QC20 / maxEE 2,2 / ITSxpress** 결과로 고정하며 다른 preprocessing 조합과의 비교는 포함하지 않음.

## NGS info

```{r ngs-summary}
depth_summary <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type, Control_Type, Subject) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N = as.integer(dplyr::n()),
    Min = as.integer(min(Read_Depth)),
    Max = as.integer(max(Read_Depth)),
    Median = round(stats::median(Read_Depth), 1),
    Mean = round(mean(Read_Depth), 1),
    SD = round(stats::sd(Read_Depth), 1),
    Qubit_Median_ng_uL = round(stats::median(Qubit_ng_uL, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

missingness <- q2_metadata |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Missing_N") |>
  dplyr::filter(Missing_N > 0) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Missing_N = as.integer(Missing_N))

datatable_basic(depth_summary, 10)
if (nrow(missingness) > 0) datatable_basic(missingness, 10)
```

```{r depth-plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.2}
depth_plot <- ggplot(
  sample_info,
  aes(x = Control_Type, y = Read_Depth, colour = Sample_Type, shape = Subject)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey45") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = subject_shapes) +
  labs(
    title = "Sequencing depth by sample/control type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Non-rarefied fungal reads (ASV table)",
    colour = "Sample type",
    shape = "Subject"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

concentration_plot <- ggplot(
  sample_info,
  aes(x = Qubit_ng_uL, y = Read_Depth, colour = Sample_Type, shape = Subject)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = subject_shapes) +
  labs(
    title = "DNA concentration and sequencing depth",
    x = "Qubit concentration (ng/µL)",
    y = "Non-rarefied fungal reads (ASV table)",
    colour = "Sample type",
    shape = "Subject"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)
  )

(depth_plot + concentration_plot) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

- Negative control에서도 fungal read가 확인되며 control type별 depth 차이가 존재함.
- 현재 입력은 ITSxpress를 포함한 최종 feature table 이후의 count이므로 NC read가 demultiplexing, primer trimming, ITS extraction, denoising/merging 또는 chimera removal 중 어느 단계에서 유지되었는지는 이 보고서만으로 판정할 수 없음.

## Rarefaction trend

- Rarefaction은 sample filtering 또는 분석 포함 기준으로 사용하지 않음.
- 각 library의 full non-rarefied count에서 sequencing depth 증가에 따른 expected observed richness 추이만 확인함.

```{r rarefaction-trend, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.5}
rarefaction_input <- t(otu_matrix)
rarefaction_curve <- vegan::rarecurve(
  rarefaction_input,
  step = 100,
  label = FALSE,
  tidy = TRUE
) |>
  dplyr::rename(SampleID = Site, Sequencing_Depth = Sample, Expected_Richness = Species) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_info |>
      dplyr::select(
        SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
        Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, Cycle_1st, Cycle_2nd
      ),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

ggplot(
  rarefaction_curve,
  aes(
    x = Sequencing_Depth,
    y = Expected_Richness,
    group = SampleID,
    colour = Sample_Type
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.48, linewidth = 0.45) +
  facet_wrap(~ PCR_Cycle_Group, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "Sequencing depth (non-rarefied reads)",
    y = "Expected observed richness (ASVs)",
    colour = "Sample type"
  )
```

## ASV abundance heatmap

- phyloseq에 포함된 전체 ASV를 동일하게 사용하여 전체 library, NC, True sample의 전반적인 abundance pattern을 각각 표시함.
- 전체 ASV heatmap은 패턴 확인이 목적이므로 row label을 표시하지 않음.
- 추가로 NC와 True의 평균 TSS relative abundance 차이를 기준으로 NC-enriched ASV 50개를 선정하고, 동일 ASV set을 NC와 True에서 각각 표시함.
- row 이름은 `ASV ID 앞 10자 | Species-level 이름`으로 통일함.

```{r heatmap-data, include=FALSE}
heatmap_info <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Site = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Region),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    ),
    Subject = dplyr::case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "Mock"
    )
  )

asv_count_heatmap <- t(otu_matrix)
asv_relative_heatmap <- asv_count_heatmap / rowSums(asv_count_heatmap)

asv_label_lookup <- taxonomy_matrix |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    FeatureID,
    tax_name = paste0(stringr::str_sub(FeatureID, 1, 10), " | ", Display_Taxon)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(tax_name = make.unique(tax_name))

control_ids <- heatmap_info |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "Control") |>
  dplyr::pull(SampleID)

true_ids <- heatmap_info |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "True") |>
  dplyr::pull(SampleID)

all_asv_ids <- colnames(asv_count_heatmap)

nc_enrichment_table <- tibble::tibble(
  FeatureID = colnames(asv_count_heatmap),
  NC_Mean_Relative = colMeans(asv_relative_heatmap[control_ids, , drop = FALSE]),
  True_Mean_Relative = colMeans(asv_relative_heatmap[true_ids, , drop = FALSE]),
  NC_Reads = as.numeric(colSums(asv_count_heatmap[control_ids, , drop = FALSE])),
  True_Reads = as.numeric(colSums(asv_count_heatmap[true_ids, , drop = FALSE])),
  NC_Prevalence = colMeans(asv_count_heatmap[control_ids, , drop = FALSE] > 0),
  True_Prevalence = colMeans(asv_count_heatmap[true_ids, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Log2_NC_to_True = log2((NC_Mean_Relative + 1e-6) / (True_Mean_Relative + 1e-6))
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(asv_label_lookup, by = "FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Log2_NC_to_True), dplyr::desc(NC_Mean_Relative))

nc_enriched_50 <- nc_enrichment_table |>
  dplyr::filter(NC_Reads > 0, Log2_NC_to_True > 0) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 50)
```

```{r heatmap-colors}
cycle_color <- c(
  "PCR1_33__PCR2_8" = "#0072B2",
  "PCR1_33__PCR2_10" = "#D55E00",
  "PCR1_35__PCR2_8" = "#009E73",
  "PCR1_35__PCR2_10" = "#CC79A7"
)

subject_levels <- sort(unique(heatmap_info$Subject))
subject_color <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")
)(length(subject_levels))
names(subject_color) <- subject_levels

site_levels <- sort(unique(heatmap_info$Site))
site_color <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
)(length(site_levels))
names(site_color) <- site_levels

control_levels <- levels(droplevels(heatmap_info$Control_Type))
control_color <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
)(length(control_levels))
names(control_color) <- control_levels

heatmap_color <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-3, 0, 3),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)
```

```{r heatmap-function}
draw_asv_heatmap <- function(
  sample_ids, feature_ids, title,
  show_sample_name = FALSE, show_row_name = TRUE
) {
  meta <- heatmap_info |>
    dplyr::filter(SampleID %in% sample_ids) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(SampleID, sample_ids))

  feature_ids <- intersect(feature_ids, colnames(asv_count_heatmap))
  log_count <- log(asv_count_heatmap[meta$SampleID, feature_ids, drop = FALSE] + 0.5)
  z_table <- t(scale(log_count))
  z_table[!is.finite(z_table)] <- 0
  z_table[z_table > 3] <- 3
  z_table[z_table < -3] <- -3
  rownames(z_table) <- asv_label_lookup$tax_name[
    match(rownames(z_table), asv_label_lookup$FeatureID)
  ]

  annotation <- data.frame(
    PCR_Cycle_Group = meta$PCR_Cycle_Group,
    Subject = meta$Subject,
    Site = meta$Site,
    Control_Type = meta$Control_Type,
    row.names = meta$SampleID,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  top_annotation <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    df = annotation,
    col = list(
      PCR_Cycle_Group = cycle_color,
      Subject = subject_color,
      Site = site_color,
      Control_Type = control_color
    ),
    simple_anno_size = grid::unit(3, "mm")
  )

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    z_table,
    name = "Log-count z score",
    col = heatmap_color,
    top_annotation = top_annotation,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = TRUE,
    show_column_names = show_sample_name,
    column_names_rot = 90,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
    show_row_names = show_row_name,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = ifelse(length(feature_ids) > 50, 5.2, 6.8)),
    column_title = title,
    border = TRUE,
    use_raster = length(feature_ids) > 200
  )
}
```

```{r all-asv-heatmaps, fig.width=17, fig.height=13}
heatmap_total <- draw_asv_heatmap(
  heatmap_info$SampleID,
  all_asv_ids,
  "All libraries — all ASVs",
  show_row_name = FALSE
)
heatmap_control <- draw_asv_heatmap(
  heatmap_info$SampleID[heatmap_info$Sample_Type == "Control"],
  all_asv_ids,
  "Negative controls — all ASVs",
  TRUE,
  FALSE
)
heatmap_true <- draw_asv_heatmap(
  heatmap_info$SampleID[heatmap_info$Sample_Type == "True"],
  all_asv_ids,
  "True samples — all ASVs",
  TRUE,
  FALSE
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_total)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_control)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_true)
```

### NC-enriched top 50 ASV: NC와 True 비교

```{r nc-enriched50-heatmaps, fig.width=17, fig.height=11}
heatmap_nc_enriched_nc <- draw_asv_heatmap(
  control_ids,
  nc_enriched_50$FeatureID,
  "Negative controls — NC-enriched top 50 ASVs",
  TRUE
)
heatmap_nc_enriched_true <- draw_asv_heatmap(
  true_ids,
  nc_enriched_50$FeatureID,
  "True samples — the same NC-enriched top 50 ASVs",
  TRUE
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_nc_enriched_nc)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmap_nc_enriched_true)
```

# 2. Alpha diversity

- 표시값: Observed ASVs, Shannon 및 library read count
- Read count는 alpha diversity 지수가 아니라 sequencing-depth QC 값이며 alpha diversity 통계 검정에서는 제외함
- 비교군: True vs Control
- 검정: 독립표본 Wilcoxon rank-sum test, paired structure 미적용
- multiple testing: 두 alpha index의 True vs Control 검정에 BH correction 적용
- 입력: non-rarefied phyloseq count의 전체 `r phyloseq::nsamples(phy)`개 library

```{r alpha-data}
alpha_diversity_data <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(
  phy,
  measures = c("Observed", "Shannon")
) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleID = stringr::str_replace(SampleID, "^X(?=\\d)", "")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c("Observed", "Shannon"),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = dplyr::recode(Metric, "Observed" = "Observed ASVs")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_info |>
      dplyr::select(
        SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
        Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group
      ),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample_Type), Sample_Type != "Mock") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_Type = droplevels(Sample_Type))

alpha_read_data <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample_Type), Sample_Type != "Mock") |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
    Sample_Type = droplevels(Sample_Type), Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group,
    Metric = "Read count",
    Value = Read_Depth
  )

alpha_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(alpha_diversity_data, alpha_read_data) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Observed ASVs", "Shannon", "Read count"))
  )

alpha_tests <- alpha_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Metric != "Read count") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Metric) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_Control = as.integer(sum(Sample_Type == "Control")),
    N_True = as.integer(sum(Sample_Type == "True")),
    Median_Control = stats::median(Value[Sample_Type == "Control"]),
    Median_True = stats::median(Value[Sample_Type == "True"]),
    P_value = stats::wilcox.test(
      Value[Sample_Type == "Control"],
      Value[Sample_Type == "True"],
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = dplyr::case_when(
      P_adjust_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

datatable_basic(alpha_tests, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Median_Control", "Median_True"), 3) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

- Observed ASVs와 Shannon에 library read count를 sequencing-depth QC 패널로 함께 표시함.

# 3. Beta diversity

- distance: non-rarefied count에서 Bray–Curtis relative abundance 및 Jaccard presence/absence를 계산함
- ordination: PCoA
- marginal plot: PCoA1 및 PCoA2의 Sample type별 density를 함께 제시함
- PERMANOVA: `Sample_Type` 단일 predictor, 999 permutations, seed 42
- dispersion: `betadisper` 후 999-permutation test
- 반복측정: `Sample_Type`이 subject/source 내부에서 변하지 않아 strata 적용 시 group 효과를 검정할 수 없음. 따라서 unstratified 결과를 탐색값으로만 제시함
- multiple testing: 두 distance의 PERMANOVA와 dispersion p-value에 각각 BH correction 적용

```{r beta-analysis}
analyse_distance <- function(distance_object, distance_name) {
  sample_ids <- attr(distance_object, "Labels")
  meta <- sample_info |>
    dplyr::filter(SampleID %in% sample_ids, Sample_Type != "Mock") |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(SampleID, sample_ids)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sample_Type = droplevels(Sample_Type),
      Control_Type = droplevels(Control_Type)
    ) |>
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
  keep_ids <- meta$SampleID
  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(distance_object)[keep_ids, keep_ids, drop = FALSE]
  distance_filtered <- stats::as.dist(distance_matrix)

  set.seed(42)
  permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
    distance_filtered ~ Sample_Type,
    data = meta,
    permutations = 999
  )
  dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(distance_filtered, meta$Sample_Type)
  set.seed(42)
  dispersion_test <- vegan::permutest(dispersion, permutations = 999)

  pcoa <- stats::cmdscale(distance_filtered, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
  variance <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]) * 100
  score <- tibble::as_tibble(pcoa$points, rownames = "SampleID") |>
    dplyr::rename(Axis1 = V1, Axis2 = V2) |>
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Distance = distance_name)

  result <- tibble::tibble(
    Distance = distance_name,
    N = as.integer(nrow(meta)),
    PERMANOVA_R2 = as.numeric(permanova$R2[1]),
    PERMANOVA_P = as.numeric(permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
    Betadisper_P = as.numeric(dispersion_test$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1])
  )

  main_plot <- ggplot(
    score,
    aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Sample_Type, shape = Control_Type)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.82) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = Sample_Type), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(
      title = distance_name,
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(variance[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(variance[2], 1), "%)"),
      colour = "Sample type",
      shape = "Control type"
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  density_score <- score |>
    dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  x_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_plot, axis = "x") +
    geom_density(
      data = density_score,
      aes(x = Axis1, fill = Sample_Type, colour = Sample_Type),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors)

  y_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_plot, axis = "y", coord_flip = TRUE) +
    geom_density(
      data = density_score,
      aes(x = Axis2, fill = Sample_Type, colour = Sample_Type),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors) +
    coord_flip()

  plot <- main_plot |>
    cowplot::insert_xaxis_grob(
      x_density,
      grid::unit(0.7, "in"),
      position = "top"
    ) |>
    cowplot::insert_yaxis_grob(
      y_density,
      grid::unit(0.7, "in"),
      position = "right"
    ) |>
    cowplot::ggdraw()

  list(result = result, plot = plot, score = score)
}

beta_sample_ids <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type != "Mock") |>
  dplyr::pull(SampleID)
beta_count <- t(otu_matrix[, beta_sample_ids, drop = FALSE])
beta_relative <- sweep(beta_count, 1, rowSums(beta_count), "/")

bray_distance <- vegan::vegdist(beta_relative, method = "bray")
jaccard_distance <- vegan::vegdist(beta_count, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

beta_results <- list(
  analyse_distance(bray_distance, "Bray–Curtis"),
  analyse_distance(jaccard_distance, "Jaccard")
)

beta_table <- purrr::map_dfr(beta_results, "result") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    PERMANOVA_P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(PERMANOVA_P, method = "BH"),
    Betadisper_P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(Betadisper_P, method = "BH")
  )

datatable_basic(beta_table, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("PERMANOVA_R2", 4) |>
  DT::formatSignif(
    c("PERMANOVA_P", "Betadisper_P", "PERMANOVA_P_adjust_BH", "Betadisper_P_adjust_BH"),
    3
  )
```

```{r beta-plots, fig.width=16, fig.height=7.5}
  beta_results[[1]]$plot,
  beta_results[[2]]$plot,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  ncol = 2
)
```

## Skin sample별 beta diversity

- Skin library만 분리하여 대상자와 좌/우 포함 site를 동시에 표시함.
- 탐색적 PERMANOVA는 `Subject + Skin_Site + PCR_Cycle_Group`를 함께 넣어 각 요인의 주변효과를 계산함.
- 동일 biological unit에서 PCR 조건이 반복되므로 permutation p-value는 확증 검정이 아니라 구조 확인용임.

```{r skin-beta-analysis}
analyse_skin_distance <- function(distance_object, distance_name) {
  skin_ids <- sample_info |>
    dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "True") |>
    dplyr::pull(SampleID)
  distance_matrix <- as.matrix(distance_object)[skin_ids, skin_ids, drop = FALSE]
  distance_skin <- stats::as.dist(distance_matrix)
  meta <- sample_info |>
    dplyr::filter(SampleID %in% skin_ids) |>
    dplyr::arrange(match(SampleID, skin_ids)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Subject = factor(Subject),
      Skin_Site = factor(Skin_Site),
      PCR_Cycle_Group = droplevels(PCR_Cycle_Group)
    ) |>
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE)

  set.seed(42)
  permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
    distance_skin ~ Subject + Skin_Site + PCR_Cycle_Group,
    data = meta,
    permutations = 999,
    by = "margin"
  )
  permanova_table <- as.data.frame(permanova) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") |>
    dplyr::filter(Term %in% c("Subject", "Skin_Site", "PCR_Cycle_Group")) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Distance = distance_name,
      Term,
      Df = as.integer(Df),
      R2 = as.numeric(R2),
      F = as.numeric(F),
      P_value = as.numeric(`Pr(>F)`)
    )

  pcoa <- stats::cmdscale(distance_skin, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
  variance <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0] / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]) * 100
  score <- tibble::as_tibble(pcoa$points, rownames = "SampleID") |>
    dplyr::rename(Axis1 = V1, Axis2 = V2) |>
    dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Distance = distance_name)

  skin_subject_levels <- sort(unique(score$Subject))
  skin_subject_color <- subject_pair_colors
  if (!all(skin_subject_levels %in% names(skin_subject_color))) {
    skin_subject_color <- setNames(
      scales::hue_pal()(length(skin_subject_levels)),
      skin_subject_levels
    )
  }
  skin_site_levels <- sort(unique(score$Skin_Site))
  skin_site_shape <- setNames(rep(0:24, length.out = length(skin_site_levels)), skin_site_levels)

  main_plot <- ggplot(
    score,
    aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = Subject, shape = Skin_Site)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.84) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = Subject), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = skin_subject_color) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = skin_site_shape) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(distance_name, " — skin samples"),
      x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(variance[1], 1), "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(variance[2], 1), "%)"),
      colour = "Subject",
      shape = "Skin site"
    ) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  x_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_plot, axis = "x") +
    geom_density(
      data = score,
      aes(x = Axis1, fill = Subject, colour = Subject),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = skin_subject_color) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = skin_subject_color)

  y_density <- cowplot::axis_canvas(main_plot, axis = "y", coord_flip = TRUE) +
    geom_density(
      data = score,
      aes(x = Axis2, fill = Subject, colour = Subject),
      alpha = 0.25,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = skin_subject_color) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = skin_subject_color) +
    coord_flip()

  plot <- main_plot |>
    cowplot::insert_xaxis_grob(
      x_density, grid::unit(0.7, "in"), position = "top"
    ) |>
    cowplot::insert_yaxis_grob(
      y_density, grid::unit(0.7, "in"), position = "right"
    ) |>
    cowplot::ggdraw()

  list(result = permanova_table, plot = plot, score = score)
}

skin_beta_results <- list(
  analyse_skin_distance(bray_distance, "Bray–Curtis"),
  analyse_skin_distance(jaccard_distance, "Jaccard")
)

skin_beta_table <- purrr::map_dfr(skin_beta_results, "result") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Term) |>
  dplyr::mutate(P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

datatable_basic(skin_beta_table, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("R2", "F"), 4) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)

skin_pcoa_scores <- purrr::map_dfr(skin_beta_results, "score") |>
  dplyr::select(
    Distance, SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site,
    PCR_Cycle_Group, Axis1, Axis2
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Distance, Subject, Skin_Site, PCR_Cycle_Group)

datatable_basic(skin_pcoa_scores, 15) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Axis1", "Axis2"), 5)
```

```{r skin-beta-plots, fig.width=16, fig.height=8.5}
cowplot::plot_grid(
  skin_beta_results[[1]]$plot,
  skin_beta_results[[2]]$plot,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  ncol = 2
)
```

- PERMANOVA와 betadisper를 함께 확인해야 centroid 차이와 dispersion 차이를 구분할 수 있음.
- group과 subject/source가 완전히 분리되어 있어 현재 p-value는 biological replicate 수준의 확증 통계로 해석할 수 없음.

# 4. Taxonomic composition

- taxonomic level: Species
- 표시 기준: 전체 sample의 TSS relative abundance 평균이 1%를 초과하는 taxa
- 분석 단위: non-rarefied species count의 sample별 relative abundance
- taxa 차이: 평균 TSS relative abundance 1% 초과 taxa의 True vs Control library-level Wilcoxon test 및 BH correction

```{r taxonomy-data}
display_lookup <- taxonomy_matrix |>
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, Display_Taxon)

relative_matrix <- sweep(otu_matrix, 2, colSums(otu_matrix), "/")
relative_long <- as.data.frame(t(relative_matrix), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "FeatureID", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") |>
  dplyr::left_join(display_lookup, by = "FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_info |>
      dplyr::select(
        SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
        Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, Cycle_1st, Cycle_2nd
      ),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

species_relative <- relative_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
    Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, Display_Taxon
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_taxa <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::group_by(Display_Taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Mean = mean(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Mean)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Mean > 0.01)

composition_data <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Display_Taxon = dplyr::if_else(
      Display_Taxon %in% top_taxa$Display_Taxon,
      Display_Taxon,
      "Others"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    SampleID, Subject, Region, Direction, Skin_Site, Biological_Unit,
    Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, Display_Taxon
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop")

composition_summary <- composition_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group, Display_Taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop")

taxon_levels <- c(top_taxa$Display_Taxon, "Others")
brewer_taxon_pool <- c(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Accent")
)
taxon_colors <- stats::setNames(
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(brewer_taxon_pool)(length(taxon_levels)),
  taxon_levels
)
taxon_colors["Others"] <- "#D9D9D9"

taxa_tests <- species_relative |>
  dplyr::filter(Display_Taxon %in% top_taxa$Display_Taxon, Sample_Type != "Mock") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_Type = droplevels(Sample_Type)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Display_Taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Control = mean(Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "Control"]),
    Mean_True = mean(Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "True"]),
    Prevalence_Control = mean(Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "Control"] > 0),
    Prevalence_True = mean(Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "True"] > 0),
    P_value = stats::wilcox.test(
      Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "Control"],
      Relative_Abundance[Sample_Type == "True"],
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = dplyr::case_when(
      P_adjust_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_adjust_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(P_adjust_BH)

datatable_basic(taxa_tests, max(10, nrow(taxa_tests))) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(
    c("Mean_Control", "Mean_True", "Prevalence_Control", "Prevalence_True"),
    1
  ) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)
```

## 전체 SampleID별 relative composition과 read count

- 두 그림 모두 x축은 factor형 `PCR_Cycle_Group`이며 `33/8 → 33/10 → 35/8 → 35/10` 순서로 고정함.
- facet strip은 `Sample type → Subject → Site` 순서로 중첩함.
- Control의 Subject는 `Control`로 통일하고 Site에는 `Air swab`, `Clean bench swab`, `Empty tube`를 표시함.
- 두 그림은 동일한 taxa 분류 기준과 색상을 사용함.

```{r overall-sample-composition-data, include=FALSE}
sample_facet_info <- sample_info |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type %in% c("Control", "True")) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    SampleID,
    Sample_Type = droplevels(Sample_Type),
    Subject_Facet = dplyr::if_else(Sample_Type == "True", as.character(Subject), "Control"),
    Site_Facet = dplyr::if_else(
      Sample_Type == "True", as.character(Skin_Site), as.character(Control_Type)
    ),
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(PCR_Cycle_Group, levels = cycle_levels)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Sample_Type, Subject_Facet, Site_Facet, PCR_Cycle_Group, SampleID)

overall_sample_order <- sample_facet_info$SampleID

overall_relative_composition <- composition_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type %in% c("Control", "True")) |>
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Display_Taxon, Relative_Abundance) |>
  dplyr::left_join(sample_facet_info, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = overall_sample_order),
    Display_Taxon = factor(Display_Taxon, levels = rev(taxon_levels))
  )

asv_count_long <- as.data.frame(t(otu_matrix), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "FeatureID", values_to = "Reads") |>
  dplyr::left_join(display_lookup, by = "FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Display_Taxon = dplyr::if_else(
      Display_Taxon %in% top_taxa$Display_Taxon, Display_Taxon, "Others"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SampleID, Display_Taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop")

overall_read_composition <- asv_count_long |>
  dplyr::left_join(sample_facet_info, by = "SampleID") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample_Type)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    SampleID = factor(SampleID, levels = overall_sample_order),
    Display_Taxon = factor(Display_Taxon, levels = rev(taxon_levels))
  )
```

# 5. Control–True 간 통계적 비교

## 동일 PCR 조건에서 Control source 간 ASV 공유: ternary plot

- 동일 PCR 조건에서 각 ASV의 Air swab, Clean bench swab, Empty tube 평균 TSS relative abundance를 계산함.
- 꼭짓점은 한 control source 특이적 ASV, 변은 두 source 공유 ASV, 중앙은 세 source 공유 ASV를 의미함.
- 점 색은 Genus, 점 크기는 세 control source에서의 평균 relative abundance 합을 나타냄.

```{r control-ternary-data}
control_ternary_long <- as.data.frame(t(relative_matrix), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-SampleID, names_to = "FeatureID", values_to = "Relative_Abundance") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sample_info |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID, Sample_Type, Control_Type, PCR_Cycle_Group),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type == "Control") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    PCR_Cycle_Group = factor(PCR_Cycle_Group, levels = cycle_levels),
    Control_Key = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Control_Type),
      "Air swab" = "Air",
      "Clean bench swab" = "Clean",
      "Empty tube" = "Empty"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(PCR_Cycle_Group, Control_Key, FeatureID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Control_Key,
    values_from = Mean_Relative_Abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    taxonomy_matrix |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        FeatureID,
        Genus = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", stringr::str_replace_all(Genus, "_", " ")
        )
      ),
    by = "FeatureID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Control_Total = Air + Clean + Empty,
    Air_Fraction = dplyr::if_else(Control_Total > 0, Air / Control_Total, 0),
    Clean_Fraction = dplyr::if_else(Control_Total > 0, Clean / Control_Total, 0),
    Empty_Fraction = dplyr::if_else(Control_Total > 0, Empty / Control_Total, 0),
    Ternary_X = Empty_Fraction + 0.5 * Air_Fraction,
    Ternary_Y = sqrt(3) / 2 * Air_Fraction,
    N_Control_Sources = as.integer(Air > 0) + as.integer(Clean > 0) + as.integer(Empty > 0),
    Sharing_Pattern = dplyr::case_when(
      Air > 0 & Clean > 0 & Empty > 0 ~ "Air + Clean + Empty",
      Air > 0 & Clean > 0 ~ "Air + Clean",
      Air > 0 & Empty > 0 ~ "Air + Empty",
      Clean > 0 & Empty > 0 ~ "Clean + Empty",
      Air > 0 ~ "Air only",
      Clean > 0 ~ "Clean only",
      Empty > 0 ~ "Empty only",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(Control_Total > 0)

control_sharing_summary <- control_ternary_long |>
  dplyr::count(PCR_Cycle_Group, Sharing_Pattern, name = "N_ASVs") |>
  dplyr::arrange(PCR_Cycle_Group, dplyr::desc(N_ASVs))

genus_levels_ternary <- control_ternary_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(Genus) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Abundance = sum(Control_Total), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Abundance)) |>
  dplyr::pull(Genus)
genus_colors_ternary <- stats::setNames(
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Accent")
  ))(length(genus_levels_ternary)),
  genus_levels_ternary
)
control_ternary_long <- control_ternary_long |>
  dplyr::mutate(Genus = factor(Genus, levels = genus_levels_ternary))

datatable_basic(control_sharing_summary, 15)

control_comparison_dir <- params$output_results_dir
dir.create(control_comparison_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(
  control_ternary_long,
  file.path(control_comparison_dir, "Control_source_ASV_ternary_coordinates.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  control_sharing_summary,
  file.path(control_comparison_dir, "Control_source_ASV_sharing_summary.csv")
)
```

```{r control-ternary-plot, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
ternary_triangle <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(0, 1, 0.5, 0),
  y = c(0, 0, sqrt(3) / 2, 0)
)

set.seed(261014)
for (one_cycle in cycle_levels) {
  one_ternary <- control_ternary_long |>
    dplyr::filter(PCR_Cycle_Group == one_cycle)

  p_one_ternary <- ggplot(one_ternary, aes(Ternary_X, Ternary_Y)) +
    geom_path(
      data = ternary_triangle,
      aes(x, y),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.65,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = Genus, size = Control_Total),
      alpha = 0.78,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.012, height = 0.010, seed = 261014)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.055,
             label = "Air swab", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = -0.03, y = -0.035,
             label = "Clean bench", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 1.03, y = -0.035,
             label = "Empty tube", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-0.12, 1.12), ylim = c(-0.08, 0.96), clip = "off") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colors_ternary, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(trans = "sqrt", range = c(2.2, 8), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("ASV sharing among control sources: ", one_cycle),
      subtitle = "Mean TSS relative abundance; slight jitter separates overlapping ASVs",
      colour = "Genus"
    ) +
    theme_void(base_family = "Noto Sans CJK KR", base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p_one_ternary)
}
```

## Focal fungal taxa의 ASV 공유 및 read abundance

- 동일 ASV 여부는 동일한 ITSxpress feature table의 exact-sequence FeatureID가 Control과 True 양쪽에서 검출되는지를 기준으로 판정함.
- 분석 대상은 `Malassezia` genus 전체, species label이 `Alternaria_g`인 ASV, `Cutaneotrichosporon_debeurmannianum` ASV임.
- read 수는 rarefaction하지 않은 ASV count이며, library 수 차이를 보완하기 위해 prevalence와 group total read fraction도 함께 제시함.

```{r malassezia-asv-data}
focal_taxa_lookup <- taxonomy_matrix |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Focal_Taxon = dplyr::case_when(
      Genus == "Malassezia" ~ "Malassezia",
      Species == "Alternaria_g" ~ "Alternaria_g",
      Species == "Cutaneotrichosporon_debeurmannianum" ~
        "Cutaneotrichosporon_debeurmannianum",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Focal_Taxon)) |>
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, Focal_Taxon, Species, Genus, Display_Taxon)

focal_ids <- focal_taxa_lookup$FeatureID

focal_asv <- tibble::tibble(
  FeatureID = focal_ids,
  Control_Reads = as.numeric(rowSums(otu_matrix[focal_ids, control_ids, drop = FALSE])),
  True_Reads = as.numeric(rowSums(otu_matrix[focal_ids, true_ids, drop = FALSE])),
  Control_Prevalence = rowMeans(otu_matrix[focal_ids, control_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0),
  True_Prevalence = rowMeans(otu_matrix[focal_ids, true_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Total_Reads = Control_Reads + True_Reads,
    Control_Read_Fraction = Control_Reads / sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy)[control_ids]),
    True_Read_Fraction = True_Reads / sum(phyloseq::sample_sums(phy)[true_ids]),
    Detection = dplyr::case_when(
      Control_Reads > 0 & True_Reads > 0 ~ "Shared ASV",
      Control_Reads > 0 ~ "Control only",
      True_Reads > 0 ~ "True only",
      TRUE ~ "Not detected"
    ),
    Detection = factor(
      Detection,
      levels = c("Shared ASV", "Control only", "True only", "Not detected")
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(focal_taxa_lookup, by = "FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::left_join(asv_label_lookup, by = "FeatureID") |>
  dplyr::arrange(Focal_Taxon, dplyr::desc(Total_Reads))

focal_overlap_summary <- focal_asv |>
  dplyr::count(Focal_Taxon, Detection, name = "N_ASVs") |>
  tidyr::complete(Focal_Taxon, Detection, fill = list(N_ASVs = 0L))

datatable_basic(focal_overlap_summary, 15)
datatable_basic(
  focal_asv |>
    dplyr::select(
      Focal_Taxon, FeatureID, tax_name, Detection, Control_Reads, True_Reads,
      Control_Prevalence, True_Prevalence,
      Control_Read_Fraction, True_Read_Fraction
    ),
  15
) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(
    c("Control_Prevalence", "True_Prevalence", "Control_Read_Fraction", "True_Read_Fraction"),
    3
  ) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Control_Reads", "True_Reads"), 0)
```

```{r malassezia-asv-plots, fig.width=14, fig.height=9, results='asis'}
focal_detection_colors <- c(
  "Shared ASV" = "#7570B3",
  "Control only" = group_colors[["Control"]],
  "True only" = group_colors[["True"]],
  "Not detected" = "grey70"
)

for (one_taxon in unique(focal_asv$Focal_Taxon)) {
  one_focal <- focal_asv |>
    dplyr::filter(Focal_Taxon == one_taxon)

  label_focal <- one_focal |>
    dplyr::slice_max(Total_Reads, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

  p_focal_scatter <- ggplot(
    one_focal,
    aes(Control_Reads + 1, True_Reads + 1, colour = Detection, size = Total_Reads)
  ) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.78) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_focal,
      aes(label = tax_name),
      size = 2.7, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = focal_detection_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 8), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(one_taxon, " ASV abundance: Control vs True"),
      x = "Control reads + 1", y = "True reads + 1", colour = "Detection"
    )

  one_focal_top <- one_focal |>
    dplyr::slice_max(Total_Reads, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::select(tax_name, Control_Reads, True_Reads) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      c(Control_Reads, True_Reads), names_to = "Sample_Group", values_to = "Reads"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sample_Group = dplyr::recode(
        Sample_Group, Control_Reads = "Control", True_Reads = "True"
      ),
      tax_name = factor(tax_name, levels = rev(unique(tax_name)))
    )

  p_focal_bar <- ggplot(
    one_focal_top,
    aes(tax_name, Reads, fill = Sample_Group)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.72) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma(), oob = scales::squish) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors[c("Control", "True")]) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(one_taxon, " ASV raw read counts"),
      x = NULL, y = "Reads (log10 scale)", fill = "Sample group"
    )

  print(
    p_focal_scatter / p_focal_bar +
      patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.4))
  )
}
```

# 6. PCR cycle에 대한 심층 분석

- True와 Control을 분리하여 PCR1 및 PCR2 cycle 증가에 따라 검출 ASV 수와 ASV별 abundance가 어떻게 달라지는지 확인함.
- ASV별 모델은 `log10(TSS relative abundance + 1e-6)`를 반응값으로 사용함.
- True에서는 `Subject × Skin site`, Control에서는 control subject/source를 고정효과로 포함하여 biological unit 차이를 보정함.
- `Combined cycle effect`는 33/8에서 35/10으로 변할 때의 예상 변화인 `2 × PCR1 coefficient + 2 × PCR2 coefficient`로 정의함.
- 탐색 분석이므로 effect direction과 BH-adjusted p-value를 함께 보고, decontam 또는 filtering 기준으로 직접 사용하지 않음.

## PCR cycle 증가 ASV와 sequence length

```{r pcr-asv-effect-analysis}
pcr_asv_long <- relative_long |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample_Type %in% c("Control", "True")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cycle_1st = as.numeric(as.character(Cycle_1st)),
    Cycle_2nd = as.numeric(as.character(Cycle_2nd)),
    Pairing_Unit = dplyr::if_else(
      Sample_Type == "True", as.character(Biological_Unit), as.character(Subject)
    ),
    Pairing_Unit = factor(Pairing_Unit),
    Log10_Relative = log10(Relative_Abundance + 1e-6)
  )

fit_pcr_effect <- function(df) {
  fit <- try(
    stats::lm(Log10_Relative ~ Cycle_1st + Cycle_2nd + Pairing_Unit, data = df),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      Beta_PCR1 = NA_real_, P_PCR1 = NA_real_,
      Beta_PCR2 = NA_real_, P_PCR2 = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  get_coef <- function(term, column) {
    if (term %in% rownames(coef_table)) as.numeric(coef_table[term, column]) else NA_real_
  }
  tibble::tibble(
    Beta_PCR1 = get_coef("Cycle_1st", "Estimate"),
    P_PCR1 = get_coef("Cycle_1st", "Pr(>|t|)"),
    Beta_PCR2 = get_coef("Cycle_2nd", "Estimate"),
    P_PCR2 = get_coef("Cycle_2nd", "Pr(>|t|)")
  )
}

pcr_asv_effect <- pcr_asv_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type, FeatureID) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~ fit_pcr_effect(.x)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Q_PCR1 = stats::p.adjust(P_PCR1, method = "BH"),
    Q_PCR2 = stats::p.adjust(P_PCR2, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Combined_Cycle_Effect = 2 * Beta_PCR1 + 2 * Beta_PCR2,
    Effect_Direction = dplyr::case_when(
      Combined_Cycle_Effect > 0 ~ "Increases with cycles",
      Combined_Cycle_Effect < 0 ~ "Decreases with cycles",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    readr::read_csv(
      "Results/01_Preprocessing/05a_unresolved_taxa_ASV_metrics.csv",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |>
      dplyr::filter(Method == "ITSxpress") |>
      dplyr::select(FeatureID, Length_bp),
    by = "FeatureID"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(asv_label_lookup, by = "FeatureID")

pcr_increasing_top <- pcr_asv_effect |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(Combined_Cycle_Effect), Combined_Cycle_Effect > 0) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(Combined_Cycle_Effect, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(Sample_Type, dplyr::desc(Combined_Cycle_Effect))

safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(keep) < 4 || stats::sd(x[keep]) == 0 || stats::sd(y[keep]) == 0) {
    return(c(Rho = NA_real_, P_value = NA_real_))
  }
  test <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[keep], y[keep], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  c(Rho = unname(test$estimate), P_value = test$p.value)
}

pcr_length_correlation <- pcr_asv_effect |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(Length_bp), is.finite(Combined_Cycle_Effect)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_Type) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    all_result <- safe_spearman(.x$Length_bp, .x$Combined_Cycle_Effect)
    positive <- .x |> dplyr::filter(Combined_Cycle_Effect > 0)
    positive_result <- safe_spearman(positive$Length_bp, positive$Combined_Cycle_Effect)
    tibble::tibble(
      ASV_Set = c("All modeled ASVs", "Increasing ASVs"),
      N_ASVs = c(nrow(.x), nrow(positive)),
      Spearman_Rho = c(all_result[["Rho"]], positive_result[["Rho"]]),
      P_value = c(all_result[["P_value"]], positive_result[["P_value"]])
    )
  }) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::group_by(ASV_Set) |>
  dplyr::mutate(P_adjust_BH = stats::p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

datatable_basic(pcr_increasing_top, 15) |>
  DT::formatRound(
    c("Beta_PCR1", "Beta_PCR2", "Combined_Cycle_Effect", "Q_PCR1", "Q_PCR2"),
    4
  )
datatable_basic(pcr_length_correlation, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Spearman_Rho", 4) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("P_value", "P_adjust_BH"), 3)

pcr_results_dir <- params$output_results_dir
dir.create(pcr_results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(pcr_asv_effect, file.path(pcr_results_dir, "PCR_cycle_ASV_effects.csv"))
readr::write_csv(pcr_length_correlation, file.path(pcr_results_dir, "PCR_cycle_ASV_length_correlation.csv"))
readr::write_csv(focal_asv, file.path(pcr_results_dir, "Focal_taxa_Control_True_ASV_reads.csv"))
```

# 7. 결론

```{r conclusion-text, results='asis'}
alpha_min <- alpha_tests |>
  dplyr::slice_min(P_adjust_BH, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
beta_min <- beta_table |>
  dplyr::slice_min(PERMANOVA_P_adjust_BH, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
taxa_sig_n <- sum(taxa_tests$P_adjust_BH < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(paste0(
  "- 총 ", phyloseq::nsamples(phy), "개 library와 ", phyloseq::ntaxa(phy),
  "개 ASV가 ITSxpress phyloseq object에 포함됨.\n",
  "- Rarefaction에 의한 sample filtering 없이 전체 ", phyloseq::nsamples(phy),
  "개 library에서 alpha/beta/taxa를 평가함.\n",
  "- Skin은 ", sum(sample_info$Sample_Type == "True"),
  "개 library를 대상자와 좌/우 포함 site별로 유지했으며, ",
  dplyr::n_distinct(sample_info$Biological_Unit[sample_info$Sample_Type == "True"]),
  "개 Subject × Site biological unit의 sample-level alpha, beta 및 taxa 결과를 별도 제시함.\n",
  "- Alpha diversity에서 가장 작은 BH-adjusted p-value는 ", alpha_min$Metric,
  "의 ", signif(alpha_min$P_adjust_BH, 3), "로 확인됨.\n",
  "- Beta diversity에서 가장 작은 BH-adjusted PERMANOVA p-value는 ",
  beta_min$Distance, "의 ", signif(beta_min$PERMANOVA_P_adjust_BH, 3),
  "이며, subject/source confounding으로 확증적 해석은 제한됨.\n",
  "- 평균 TSS relative abundance 1% 초과 species 중 library-level True–Control 비교에서 BH-adjusted p < 0.05인 taxon은 ",
  taxa_sig_n, "개로 확인됨.\n",
  "- Negative control의 read와 taxonomic profile이 확인되어 후속 decontam 평가가 필요함."
))
```

# 8. 한계점 및 향후 분석 예정

- Skin은 2명과 좌/우 포함 9개 해부학적 site로 구성되며, Subject × Site별 결과를 개별 sample 수준으로 제시했지만 대상자 수가 2명뿐이므로 일반화가 제한됨.
- 동일 source/subject에서 PCR cycle 조건이 반복되어 library-level Wilcoxon 및 PERMANOVA의 독립성 가정이 충족되지 않음.
- 현재 metadata에 Mock sample이 없어 positive-control recovery 및 expected composition을 평가하지 못함.
- 본 보고서는 QC20 / maxEE 2,2 / ITSxpress로 고정되어 있어 preprocessing parameter 간 비교를 수행하지 않음.
- 현재 count는 최종 feature table 단계의 산출물이므로 NC read가 유입 또는 유지된 정확한 pipeline stage를 특정하지 못함.
- taxonomy는 preprocessing 단계에서 ASV별로 결합된 결과를 사용함. Species 미분류 ASV가 존재하므로 taxonomic resolution과 sequence-level evidence를 함께 확인해야 함.
- Rarefaction은 observed richness trend 확인에만 사용했으며 sample filtering 또는 diversity 계산 입력으로 사용하지 않음.
- decontam method, threshold 및 contaminant removal은 적용하지 않음.

향후 분석 우선순위:

1. QC20 / maxEE 2,2 / ITSxpress의 DADA2 및 ITSxpress 단계별 read tracking table을 현재 SampleID와 통합함.
2. batch balance와 control source 구성을 확인한 후 pooled 또는 batch-stratified decontam 여부 및 method를 결정함.
3. 승인된 decontam 설정에서 threshold sensitivity와 alpha/beta/taxa before–after 비교를 수행함.
